export DRIVE_SESSION_TAG="nothingness_linux_debug"; export DRIVE_TARGET=linux; export DRIVE_RUN_LOG="/tmp/flutter_run_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}.log"; FIX=$(ls -1 /opt/nothingness/media/*.opus | sort | paste -sd, -); .agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py call ext.nothingness.getPlaybackState | python3 - <<'PY'
import sys, json, os
from pathlib import Path
state=json.load(sys.stdin)
queue=state['queue']
qpaths=[t['path'] for t in queue]
fixture=set(str(p) for p in sorted(Path('/opt/nothingness/media').glob('*.opus')))
assert len(qpaths)==10, len(qpaths)
assert len(set(qpaths))==10, 'duplicate in queue'
assert set(qpaths)==fixture, 'queue paths mismatch fixtures'
print('queue_ok')
before='/opt/nothingness/media/01-undercover-49.opus'
after='/opt/nothingness/media/09-undercover-46.opus'
assert before in fixture and after in fixture
assert before!=after
print('transition_ok', before,'->',after)
PY
